site.name: MboteData
site.tagline: Kokanisa mpe kosomba ba forfait ya eSIM na Kongo — futa na Bitcoin Lightning to na mobile money.

home.heroSubtitle: Tala mpe kokanisa ba forfait ya eSIM ya ba réseaux ya solo, na nsima futa ndenge olingi — na portefeuille Lightning to na mbongo ya mobile money.
home.step1Body: Tala ba forfait ya eSIM ya Kongo na ntalo, données, mpe ntango ekowumela.
home.step2Body: Futa na portefeuille Bitcoin Lightning, to na M-Pesa / mobile money na nzela ya Machankura — carte bancaire te.
home.step3Body: Code QR ya eSIM na yo ekoya na ba instructions nsima ya kondimama ya paiement.
